requirements.contract: Exactly one Professional Knowledge owner exists; Slice 17 does not duplicate InterventionDefinition or another professional truth.
Every Knowledge Item has a stable identity and every substantive semantic version has an exact immutable version identity.
Every publishable version carries content, language/locale, scene/purpose, stage, age/development scope, applicability, exclusions, risk and attributable source provenance required by its scope.
Missing required applicability/exclusion/risk metadata never means universal applicability.
Required professional source identity/provenance must be reviewable; unresolved/unverifiable required provenance prevents production release.
Professional Knowledge content/source metadata does not become a store for identifiable Family/child Case data.
A pre-release candidate/draft is never production selectable.
A review activity/result is auditable but cannot by itself produce Professional Approval.
APPROVED production status requires a current external Professional Approval proof exactly bound to the Knowledge artifact/version/hash/source/scope and reviewer authority/qualification facts.
A substantive content/source/applicability/exclusion/risk/scope change invalidates the old approval match for new production use and requires successor/fresh review/approval as applicable.
PUBLISHED/released Knowledge requires complete metadata, exact current Professional Approval proof and all applicable release gates.
New production use requires exact Scene Package version → Knowledge version binding through the authoritative Scene Package owner; no floating latest.
Only exact PUBLISHED/released + CURRENT/VALID + currently approved + scope-matching Knowledge may be production eligible.
Wrong scene/stage/age/applicability/exclusion/risk/locale/required scope fails closed.
Superseded/retired/expired/unusable versions cannot be selected for new production use while historical identity remains.
A terminal/superseded released version is not reactivated by in-place semantic mutation; substantive correction uses a successor.
Released content and the semantic metadata covered by its approval hash are immutable.
Scene Package Knowledge-set history remains exact, inspectable and owned by the Scene Package authority.
Knowledge and InterventionDefinition lifecycle/approval remain independent; optional cross-reference is exact and explanatory only.
Knowledge never decides Intervention eligibility, Plan activation, Safety outcome, Case truth or Formulation truth.
Professional asset administration uses current Staff Authority capability/assignment/scope and cannot be granted by Family roles.
Family-facing downstream consumption composes current actor/family/case/purpose Authorization before content use.
Unauthorized callers cannot infer protected Knowledge/package/reviewer/approval/unpublished existence through externally distinguishable errors.
Knowledge lifecycle/administration cannot create, modify or infer Consent truth.
Compliance/age/purpose authority remains external and cannot be overridden by Knowledge labels.
Safety authority remains external; Knowledge cannot clear or downgrade Safety controls.
AI-assisted content remains candidate until real authority proof exists; AI cannot approve/publish by self-certification.
Mutating Knowledge commands reuse the repository's shared exact-replay / mismatch-conflict idempotency semantics.
Stale revisions and concurrent transitions cannot last-write-win over newer Knowledge state/proof/binding.

Successful release/lifecycle mutation atomically binds the required exact Knowledge state plus proof/binding/audit/idempotency evidence owned by that transaction; partial authority truth is forbidden.
Partial failure rolls back business effects; timeout/unknown outcome requires authoritative readback.
Professional Knowledge lifecycle, proof consumption, source impact and release decisions are auditable without sensitive/private/full-source leakage.
Source/approval/package/upstream change propagates NEEDS_REVIEW or invalidation only to genuinely affected Knowledge/dependents while preserving history.
Slice 17 creates no embedding, chunk, vector/lexical retrieval, RAG, model runtime, Context Builder or Phase 4 truth.
Tests prove the protocol without promoting synthetic reviewer/qualification/approval fixtures into production.
Wrong/unknown package/version/hash/proof never falls back to a different package, version or nearest content.
An empty genuinely approved/published Knowledge set remains truthful unavailable/empty rather than synthetic content.
Professional Knowledge does not create another Evidence, Problem Formulation, Family Memory or source-of-family-truth store.
Stale cached/downstream references cannot make unapproved, NEEDS_REVIEW, invalid, retired, superseded or expired Knowledge production eligible.
Development Implement Gate and Professional Production Release Gate are independent; development may proceed fail-closed while professional release remains blocked.
Knowledge lifecycle_status is independent from review_state / validity_state; NEEDS_REVIEW is never a lifecycle value.
NEEDS_REVIEW suppresses use as an unaffected authoritative production basis without mechanically changing lifecycle.
Review resolution follows: no material impact → CURRENT/VALID; material impact → successor + fresh approval; cannot legally/professionally continue → invalid/unusable.
PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW capability + valid Staff assignment are necessary operation-authority facts but never substitute for matching professional qualification or approval proof.
Professional qualification is consumed as an independent scoped fact and is not manufactured by Slice 17.

Exact approval proof binds Knowledge identity/version/hash, source refs, approval scope, proof identity, reviewer identity, Staff authority reference, qualification reference/scope and effective/reviewed/publication timing.
Professional Authority unavailable and Professional Authority invalid/mismatched remain distinct internal fail-closed outcomes; neither becomes approval.
Slice 17 is an approval-proof consumer and may retain bounded immutable proof evidence, but local persistence never becomes the authority that creates approval.
Professional Content Package and Scene Package are distinct; Slice 17 creates neither a generic Professional Content Package registry nor a second Scene Package registry.
Current APPROVED PROFESSIONAL REVIEWER — UNASSIGNED state forbids production professional approval/release but does not forbid development of candidate/version/proof-consumer foundation.
Canonical professional source identity is reused when available; Slice 17 stores only the immutable Knowledge-review provenance snapshot/reference needed for its own truth.

Current Authority does not impose a separate publisher capability or reviewer/publisher separation of duties; publication still requires authorized Staff operation plus a valid exact Professional Approval proof, and no reviewer==publisher shortcut is assumed.
Authorized candidate-authoring path creates a complete Knowledge candidate; it remains nonproduction.
Candidate content with no Professional Approval proof cannot be released.
A Staff actor with PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW capability but no matching qualification cannot create valid Professional Approval.
A matching qualification without valid Staff assignment/capability cannot create valid Professional Approval.
Family Manager/Guardian/Case owner cannot administer professional Knowledge merely because Family authorization is valid.
An AI identity, developer flag, approved=true field or production configuration cannot manufacture approval.
A test-only synthetic provider can prove protocol behavior but is structurally unreachable as production authority.
Exact real approval proof matching Knowledge id/version/hash/source/scope/reviewer/qualification is accepted as external authority evidence.
Same proof with wrong Knowledge version fails closed.
Same proof with wrong content hash fails closed.
Same proof with changed source refs fails closed.
Same proof with wrong approval scope fails closed.
Revoked/expired/unverifiable Staff authority proof fails closed.
Missing/revoked/expired/mismatched professional qualification fails closed.
Expired/revoked Professional Approval proof prevents new production use without rewriting Knowledge lifecycle.
Professional Authority provider unavailable yields truthful dependency-unavailable behavior, not approved=false fabricated authority.
Reviewed activity without APPROVED external proof remains nonproduction.
APPROVED external proof without publication/release does not make Knowledge family-facing production content.
PUBLISHED/released Knowledge with review_state NEEDS_REVIEW is excluded from new authoritative production use.
No-material-impact re-review restores CURRENT/VALID without changing lifecycle.
Material source/content/scope change creates a successor version and requires fresh approval.
Source withdrawal that makes current use invalid immediately suppresses new use and preserves historical citations.

Approval expires while content/hash/source/scope is unchanged; production use stops, and a later new valid proof for that same exact version restores eligibility without forced Knowledge content-version churn.
Scene Package v1 historical binding remains unchanged when Scene Package v2 binds another Knowledge version.
Scene Package supersession alone does not mark unrelated Knowledge NEEDS_REVIEW.
Scene Package change that materially changes Knowledge applicability marks only affected Knowledge NEEDS_REVIEW.
Knowledge exact InterventionDefinition reference becomes superseded; affected explanatory content enters NEEDS_REVIEW when material, but no Intervention eligibility is changed by Knowledge.
Knowledge explaining an unapproved InterventionDefinition cannot make the Intervention eligible.
Wrong scene/stage returns no eligible content and never approximate fallback.
Wrong age/development scope fails closed.
Missing/UNKNOWN required applicability data fails closed rather than being interpreted as ALL.
Applicable exclusion or incompatible risk scope blocks content eligibility.
Wrong Scene Package version cannot resolve floating latest Knowledge.
Wrong Professional Content Package identity/version/hash cannot authorize a Knowledge version.
A Professional Content Package exists but has no valid approval proof; existence does not create approval.
An approved Professional Content Package exact version may cover an exact Knowledge version only when the proof/content binding actually matches.
Retired/superseded/expired Knowledge remains historically readable under proper authorization but unavailable for new production use.
Published content correction never overwrites the released version in place.
Same idempotency key + same semantic command replays one authoritative result.
Same idempotency key + materially different command conflicts with no duplicate business effect.
Two concurrent release/supersede/retire transitions cannot produce contradictory current truth.
Stale expected revision/proof cannot overwrite newer authoritative state.
Partial transaction failure leaves no half-released Knowledge/proof/binding/audit state.
Commit-succeeded/response-lost outcome is resolved by authoritative readback rather than guessed.
Wrong Family/Case/purpose is denied at family-facing consumption without exposing unpublished professional asset existence.
Consent withdrawal blocks affected downstream family processing while leaving generic immutable Knowledge history intact.
Compliance restriction blocks delivery even when Knowledge metadata claims an age match.
Safety Hold/control blocks affected downstream use even if Knowledge text appears reassuring.
Empty approved/published Knowledge set returns truthful empty/unavailable and no model-generated filler.
